title: Listen: recorded recitation
note: A human recording streamed on demand from the publisher. Nothing is downloaded until you press Play. Ayah highlighting follows the publisher's verified ayah timings only.
metaError: Recitation timings are unavailable right now. The text above and below stays readable.
modeAyah: An ayah (stops at the end of this surah)
modePage: A mushaf page (publisher's page numbering; stops at the end of the page)
boundarySurah: Plays from the chosen ayah to the end of Surah {{name}}.
boundaryPage: Plays page {{page}} from {{first}} and stops at the end of that page.
idle: Ready. Choose a start and press Play.
loading: Loading the recording and moving to the start…
ended: Reached the chosen end point and stopped.
needsTap: Your browser needs another tap to start audio. Press Play again.
error: The recording could not be played here (offline or blocked). The text stays readable.
nowTitle: Text of what is selected or reciting: Surah {{name}} ({{surah}}), ayah {{ayah}}
nowLoading: Loading the text of this ayah…
nowError: The text of this ayah could not be loaded. Try again.
nowMissing: This ayah is not in the delivered text.
restoreMissing: The saved ayah ({{anchor}}) was not found in this text, so the reader opened at the top of the surah.
